summary: Blends two TOP inputs using a crossfade value while transform controls position the overlay layer.

key_params.name: cross
key_params.note: Crossfade amount between input 1 and input 2

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: Overlay fit mode such as fill, fithorz, fitvert, fitbest, fitworst, or nativeres

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Overlay extend behavior: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror

common_gotchas: Transform controls do not change the blend formula; they affect overlay placement only.
Different input sizes depend on Fixed Layer and prefit choices.
Legacy Transform changes transform order and rotation behavior.
Texture array and 3D texture crossfades need matching source layout expectations.
key_concepts: Cross TOP blends two inputs with Input1 times (1 - cross) plus Input2 times cross.
Cross value 0 outputs input 1 and value 1 outputs input 2.
Fixed Layer controls default output resolution and aspect while overlay transform controls only the adjustable layer.
Prefit, justify, and extend define how the overlay aligns against the fixed layer.
The official TOP supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays.
